arxiv-2501-13709.title: Regularizing cross entropy loss via minimum entropy and K-L divergence .
arxiv-2501-13709.creator: Abdulrahman O. Ibraheem rahman.ibraheem1@outlook.com
arxiv-2501-13709.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Abdulrahman O. Ibraheem rahman.ibraheem1@outlook.com. I introduce two novel loss functions for classification in deep learning. The two loss functions extend standard cross entropy loss by regularizing it with minimum entropy and Kullback-Leibler (K-L) divergence terms. The first of the two novel loss functions is termed mixed entropy loss (MIX-ENT for short), while the second one is termed minimum entropy regularized cross-entropy loss (MIN-ENT for short).

arxiv-2501-17684.description: Abstract . The Internet of Batteryless Things revolutionizes sustainable communication as it operates on harvested energy. This harvested energy is dependent on unpredictable environmental conditions; therefore, device operations, including those of its networking stack, must be resilient to power failures.

arxiv-2512-18199.title: PROVEX: Enhancing SOC Analyst Trust with Explainable Provenance-Based IDS
arxiv-2512-18199.creator: Devang Dhanuka, Prof. Nidhi Rastogi
arxiv-2512-18199.description: Abstract Modern intrusion detection systems (IDS) leverage graph neural networks (GNNs) to detect malicious activity in system provenance data, but their decisions often remain a “black box” to analysts. This paper presents a comprehensive XAI framework designed to bridge the trust gap in Security Operations Centers (SOCs) by making graph-based detection transparent.

arxiv-2602-12881.title: Semantic Communities and Boundary-Spanning Lyrics in K-pop: A Graph-Based Unsupervised Analysis
arxiv-2602-12881.creator: Oktay Karakuş
arxiv-2602-12881.description: Abstract Large-scale lyric corpora present unique challenges for data-driven analysis, including the absence of reliable annotations, multilingual content, and high levels of stylistic repetition. Most existing approaches rely on supervised classification, genre labels, or coarse document-level representations, limiting their ability to uncover latent semantic structure.

pmc-12972705.title: All-cause health-adjusted life expectancy in Jiangxi Province, China, 2000–2030: systematic estimation and analysis
pmc-12972705.creator: Jing Ding, Sanqian Chen, Yuting Deng, Siyu Zhou, Zhang Zeng, Songbo Hu
pmc-12972705.description: ObjectivesUsing Jiangxi Province as a case study, this research aims to evaluate the progress in achieving the national “Healthy China 2030” all-cause health-adjusted life expectancy (HALE) targets at the subnational level.MethodsBased on provincial data collected between 2000 and 2020, we applied a simplified, validated model to estimate all-cause years lived with disability (YLD) rates.

pmc-13149816.title: Diagnosis and management of a severe ALK-positive pneumonia-type lung adenocarcinoma: a case report
pmc-13149816.creator: Ting Su, Qiaoli Zhang, Mengyun Wang, Qifan Jing, Jiani C Yin, Kun Wang, Jian He
pmc-13149816.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). BackgroundPneumonia-type lung adenocarcinoma (PLADC) exhibits clinical symptoms and radiographic features that mimic those of pneumonia. This often leads to misdiagnosis, which can delay appropriate treatment and result in poor outcomes, particularly in severe cases. Effective management of PLADC requires a timely and accurate diagnosis through tissue biopsy, allowing for detailed pathological examination and genetic profiling, followed by targeted therapy tailored to the patient’s condition.

pmc-13361467.title: Dynamic prognostic nutritional index and 28-day mortality in sepsis: a joint modeling analysis
pmc-13361467.creator: Feng Xu, Jinjiang Li, Wei Zhao, Shijing Ding, Jing Cao
pmc-13361467.description: BackgroundAlthough the Prognostic Nutritional Index (PNI) is associated with sepsis outcomes, admission values may primarily reflect acute illness severity. We examined whether longitudinal PNI provides prognostic value beyond baseline risk.MethodsIn this retrospective cohort study of 492 adults with sepsis, baseline PNI was assessed using Kaplan–Meier analysis and adjusted restricted cubic splines.

pmc-13369070.title: Surgeon Perceptions and Experiences with Postoperative Acute Pain Management: A Mixed-Methods Study
pmc-13369070.creator: Vinod Dasa, Scott J. Keating, Sushanth Jeyakumar, K. D. Jacobs, Lauren A. Crowder, Sloan Rucker, Alexandra J. Feld, Moeen Panni, Ann M. Menzie
pmc-13369070.description: IntroductionAlthough prior studies have examined healthcare providers’ perspectives on opioid prescribing for postoperative pain, limited research exists on surgeons’ experiences managing acute postoperative pain in adults. This study evaluated surgeons’ perceptions and experiences to better understand challenges in managing acute pain and assess perceived impacts of inadequately managed pain on patients.

pmc-13621631.title: Bacterial pathogens and antimicrobial resistance patterns in infections associated with stillbirths and under-five deaths in Ethiopia: a post-mortem surveillance study
pmc-13621631.creator: Fentabil Getnet, Dadi Marami, Shikur Mohammed, Yenework Acham, Alemnesh H Mirkuzie, Awoke Misganaw, Yimam Getaneh, Esrael Solomon, Dagne Bodena, Fami Ahmed, Daniel Demissie, Mulu Berihun, Zelalem Teklemariam, Lola Madrid, Joe O Oundo, Lulu M Muhe, Nega Assefa
pmc-13621631.description: BackgroundBacterial infections remain major contributors to stillbirth, neonatal, and under-five mortality, particularly in low-resource settings where antimicrobial resistance (AMR) increasingly threatens the management of severe infections. Despite the growing burden of AMR in Ethiopia, data on bacterial pathogens and resistance patterns contributing to child mortality remain limited.

pmc-13625796.title: Effects of adverse childhood experiences on behavior in adolescence: Insights from brain imaging and genetic risk
pmc-13625796.creator: Huaigui Liu, Jie Tang, Zhen Zhao, Yujing Zhou, Hao Ding, Nana Liu, Yuan Ji, Piaoran Wang, Xiangzheng Wu, Feng Liu, Wen Qin, Vince D Calhoun, Jiayuan Xu, Yurong Jiang
pmc-13625796.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Adolescence is a critical developmental stage, and adverse childhood experiences (ACEs) are important environmental factors influencing behavior. However, the relationship between ACEs, individual behavior, brain mechanisms, and the role of genetic risk remains underexplored. In this study, data from 9796 youths aged 9–13 years in the Adolescent Brain Cognitive Development (ABCD) study were analyzed, including 67 ACE-related variables and 30 behavioral outcomes.

uslaw-usc-t18-s2273.title: 18 U.S.C. § 2273 — Destruction of vessel by nonowner
uslaw-usc-t18-s2273.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t18-s2273.description: United States Code, Title 18 (Crimes And Criminal Procedure); Part I (Crimes); Chapter 111 (Shipping). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. Whoever, not being an owner, upon the high seas or on any other waters within the admiralty and maritime jurisdiction of the United States, willfully and corruptly casts away or otherwise destroys any vessel of the United States to which he belongs.
